Bassist Pierre Boussaguet was born in Albi, France in 1962. He has recorded and performed with the best jazz artists from both America and Europe, including Lalo Schifrin, Ray Brown and Guy Lafitte.
Pierre was interviewed in Aix en Provence, France on 7/28/2020 by Matthieu Jaffre.
